scope: A process-memory JNI and Java report-worker integration only; no Android execution or repeated standalone memory tests. Read-only A worktree.

findings.original_issue: Separate volatile JSON and timestamp fields permitted mixed sample generations.
findings.resolution: One immutable MemorySample containing json, completedAt and durationMs is published through a single volatile reference, captured once when building the report.

findings.original_issue: Repeated draining of the latest pending report within one executor task could starve already queued memory sampling/export work when writes were slow.
findings.resolution: One pending report is consumed per executor task; finally resubmits a successor, allowing previously queued tasks to run first.

remaining_limitations: Kernel proc read latency is not wall-time-bounded; sample age/duration expose delay.
The shared report executor can be delayed by a single slow storage/export operation; it does not block native rendering/audio.
New process observer still requires actual combined continuation APK emulator execution and physical Thor evidence.
